prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory member catalog. Export exactly `{ createMemberCatalog }` using CommonJS.

`createMemberCatalog()` returns `{ create, get, update, remove, authenticate, list }`.

A member has `id`, `displayName`, `email`, `plan`, and `regions`. Creation additionally requires `secret`. All strings must be non-empty, `regions` must be an array of strings, IDs and normalized lowercase emails must be unique, and the secret must contain at least eight characters. Store only a deterministic SHA-256 digest of the secret. Never expose the digest or secret.

`update(id, patch)` may change `displayName`, `email`, `plan`, `regions`, or `secret`; reject unknown fields and preserve email uniqueness. `get` returns a public member or `null`, `remove` returns whether a member existed, and `authenticate(email, secret)` returns a boolean. `list({ page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = {})` requires positive integers and returns `{ items, total, page, pageSize, pages }` in creation order; an empty catalog has zero pages. Returned objects and arrays must not alias internal state or inputs. Invalid operations throw `TypeError` or `Error` without partially modifying the catalog.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
